title: Secret roles
text: Most of the crew is loyal. A few are secret mutineers, and one of them is the Ringleader. Mutineers know each other.

title: Check your role in secret
text: Hold the button on your phone to peek. Let go and it hides again.

title: Captain picks a First Mate
text: The Captain's seat goes round the table. The Captain nominates a First Mate, then everyone talks it over.

title: Everyone votes
text: More Ayes than Nays and the pair takes charge. Three failed pairs in a row and chaos enacts the top order.

title: Orders, passed in secret
text: The Captain draws three orders and scraps one. The First Mate gets two and enacts one. Nobody sees what was thrown away.

title: Mutiny orders give powers
text: Some Mutiny orders let the Captain scan the deck, check someone's loyalty, pick the next Captain, or throw someone out of the airlock.

title: How to win
text: Crew: five Steady orders, or airlock the Ringleader. Mutiny: six Mutiny orders, or the Ringleader made First Mate after three.
